683:t_000:3.en:
$$トライア$$
「$$ＡＧ$$! How's the activation work on the $$時空震動弾$$ going!?」

683:t_000:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No problems! The link-up with the $$ソーラリアン$$'s $$Ｚクリスタル$$ is going well, too!」

683:t_000:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All that's left until it triggers is to protect $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3!」

683:t_000:6.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Be careful! The $$宇宙怪獣$$ are coming!」

683:t_001:0.en:
$$デュオ$$
「I knew it, but that's one heck of a number!」

683:t_001:1.en:
$$トロワ$$
「But even this is not their main force.」

683:t_001:2.en:
$$カトル$$
「So there are even more of them waiting in the rear.」

683:t_001:3.en:
$$五飛$$
「Then all we have to do is scatter these vanguard ones!」

683:t_001:4.en:
$$チコ$$
「There's even a $$変動重力源$$ type like the ones we fought on Earth!」

683:t_001:5.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Evolved $$宇宙怪獣$$... So they did show up, as expected.」

683:t_001:6.en:
$$カズミ$$
「We'll handle the gravitational collapse from shooting that thing down with the $$ソーラリアン$$'s dimensional transfer barrier system.」

683:t_001:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We're going to concentrate on nothing but taking that thing down!」

683:t_001:11.en:
$$宗介$$
「Will $$ノノ$$ be all right on her own?」

683:t_001:12.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「She asked to sortie in a single unit. All we can do is leave it to her will.」

683:t_001:13.en:
$n
「She's a $$バスターマシン$$ built to fight $$宇宙怪獣$$. She'll come through, no doubt about it.」

683:t_001:14.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「I'll confirm the operation once more. Our objective is, above all, the defense of $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3.」

683:t_002:0.en:
$$リーロン$$
「If an enemy gets into this area, we're done... The $$時空震動弾$$ could trigger in a half-finished state and go out of control, you know.」

683:t_002:1.en:
$$桂$$
「If things go badly, it'll be another $$大時空震動$$, huh...」

683:t_002:2.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Seven minutes until the $$時空震動弾$$ triggers!」

683:t_002:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「If we can protect $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3 for these seven minutes, it's humanity's victory!」

683:t_002:4.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Seven minutes... The future lies beyond them.」

683:t_002:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「Looks like it'll be the longest seven minutes of my life.」

683:t_003:0.en:
$$ニア$$
「The $$宇宙怪獣$$ are heading our way! The big ones seem to be targeting the new $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3!」

683:t_003:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「Let's do this, everyone! Winning just by holding out for seven minutes is a piece of cake!」

683:t_003:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Yeah! I don't know what this will of the universe is or whatever, but don't think you can take us down in just seven minutes!」

683:t_003:3.en:
$$万丈$$
「Now that it's come to this, it's a blessing that $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3 is smaller than the original.」

683:t_003:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「In short, the wind is blowing our way! We can do this!」

683:t_003:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But we don't know what will happen after this. Don't wait for the $$宇宙怪獣$$ - take the initiative and hit them!」

683:t_003:7.en:
$$シン$$
「I'll do it...! I'm going to do it!」

683:t_003:8.en:
$$甲児$$
「We'll protect it no matter what! $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3, and the universe!」

683:t_003:10.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Laugh or cry, it's only seven more minutes...!」

683:t_003:12.en:
$$シャア$$
「All units, begin the attack! We will win, no matter what!」

683:t_003:13.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Now is the time to gather everyone's sparks into a giant flame!」

683:t_003:14.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We'll light up the future with that light!」

683:t_003:16.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
(I'll be waiting, Big Sis...)

683:t_003:17.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
(I'll be waiting, Big Sis...)

683:t_004:0.en:
$$弁慶$$
「All right! We've driven off the first wave!」

683:t_004:1.en:
$$隼人$$
「Is the main force coming next!?」

683:t_005:0.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Four minutes have passed since the operation began!」

683:t_005:1.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Three minutes until the $$時空震動弾$$ triggers!」

683:t_005:2.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Let's do this! We'll keep defending it to the end!」

683:t_006:0.en:
$$リーロン$$
「I've picked up a gravity tremor! The main force is probably warping in!」

683:t_006:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「I've been waiting for this! We'll smash it and end this!」

683:t_009:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Even so, that's way too huge!」

683:t_009:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「This is... a single living creature...?」

683:t_009:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「I never expected something like that to show up! That's beyond even my estimates!」

683:t_009:6.en:
$$トライア$$
「That thing...! It's on the verge of causing a gravitational collapse of staggering scale inside its body!」

683:t_009:7.en:
$$トライア$$
「If we're unlucky, we might not even be able to send it into the gap between dimensions with the $$時空震動弾$$!」

683:t_009:10.en:
$$赤木$$
「Damn it! Why the hell did something like that have to show up!」

683:t_009:11.en:
???
「The root of it all is Earth's humanity.」

683:t_010:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Glad you came, $n... And $c.」

683:t_010:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I welcome you all from the bottom of my heart, and I rejoice at our reunion.」

683:t_010:5.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「You still don't understand the Captain's... Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s power, do you, $n?」

683:t_010:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! What did you mean by what you said just now!?」

683:t_010:8.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Exactly what I said. It was Earth's humanity that created the $$宇宙怪獣$$ you call $$変動重力源$$s.」

683:t_010:9.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「The source of the gravitational collapse inside that thing is a degeneracy reactor built by the humans of Earth in a certain world.」

683:t_010:11.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That's right... $$タカヤ・ノリコ$$, that $$変動重力源$$ is a space monster that evolved by swallowing your world's technology.」

683:t_010:12.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Furthermore, the colossal $$変動重力源$$ before your eyes has taken in an $$ヱクセリヲン$$-class degeneracy reactor.」

kept_omissions: 683:t_009:8: Aoi's 「じゃあ、あいつがいたら…！」 trails off; rendered 'Then if that thing is here...!' (the consequence is left unsaid, as in the Japanese; Banagher completes it next row).
683:t_009:3: AG's 「まずいですよ、これは…！」 rendered 'This is bad, very bad...!' (no added object).

683:t_003:13/14: Kazumi's 「今こそみんなの火を集めて巨大な炎を！」 left as an unfinished purpose clause ('Now is the time to gather ... into a giant flame!'), Noriko completes with 'We'll light up the future with that light!'
uncertain: 683:t_001:7: Noriko's 『あたし達は』 read as Noriko + Nono's group (Nono, Buster Machine No. 7 and Diebuster answer 'Yes!'), not the whole fleet.
683:t_001:13: Hibiki's あいつ = Nono ('She'), inferred from Sousuke/Kamille's preceding exchange; the 'バスターマシン' used as the bare keyword token $$バスターマシン$$.
Buster Machine No. 3 written as plain text ('Buster Machine No. 3' / 'the new Buster Machine No. 3') following finished slices 2091_04 and 2094_03; there is no sheet token for バスターマシン３号.
683:t_003:10: 泣いても笑っても = 'Laugh or cry' (alternative: 'for better or worse').
683:t_003:2: 宇宙の意思 = 'will of the universe' (no sheet entry; 'this will of the universe or whatever').
683:t_010:5: White's アドヴェント様 rendered 'Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$' (honorific dropped, matching her rows in 2059_05/2065_00); her 隊長 = 'the Captain'.
683:t_010:8: 変動重力源 pluralised as '$$変動重力源$$s' since the sentence is generic ('the space monsters you call ...'); 地球人類 = 'Earth's humanity' throughout (t_009:11, t_010:8/9).
